profile.name: Vinsmoke Niji

reasons.reason: Há benefícios condicionados a HP acima de um limite; recuperação e manutenção de HP recebem prioridade adicional.

evidence.text: When your HP is 50% or more: Remove status effects and nullify status effects inflicted by enemy.

profile.confidence: perfil com regras de traits reconhecidas

unmodeled.text:
When spawning: Acquire a defensive shield (durability: 10% of max HP).
While defensive shield is active, enemy attacks will reduce shield durability instead of HP, and it will inflict Stagger on the enemy who attacked you. (Excludes some attacks.)
When you start capturing the enemy's Treasure: Transform the Treasure Area where you are at into Electrified Treasure Area for 12 second(s). and DEF: Boosted by 50% for 12 second(s). (Cannot Stack)

Electrified Treasure Areas can unleash an area attack that deals a fixed percentage of damage (5% of the enemies' max HP, max 4 Consecutive Hits) with a chance to Shock (Very Short) for 1 second.
The Electrified transformation will disappear after you or an ally captures Treasure, after a certain amount of time passes, or after you are KO'd.

When performing a Perfect Dodge: Recover HP by 30%. and Teleport towards the enemy and unleash a mid-range multiple hit area attack that deals a fixed percentage of damage (8% of the enemies' max HP, max 4 Consecutive Hits) and Shocks them for 5 seconds.
When performing a Perfect Dodge: Recover durability of defensive shield by 50% (restores the shield if it was destroyed). and Reduce the cooldown time of dodge by 100%.
When defensive shield has durability remaining: Boost capture speed by 50%. and Can ignore the enemy and capture the Treasure.

When a damage-dealing Shock infliction has been nullified: Recover durability of defensive shield by 50% (restores the shield if it was destroyed). and Increase the cooldown time of the enemy's skill by 10%.
When performing a Perfect Dodge: Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 1 by 15%. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 2 by 30%.

limitations: Pesos e fatores são heurísticos, não oficiais nem medidos em partidas.
Não simula dano final, evolução de skills, mapas, inimigos, troca de classe ou todos os traits.
Traits adicionais não estão equipados neste ranking. Recomendações de atributos são separadas.
Condições usam os fatores gerais 0,5 e 0,25; o cenário real pode mudar a ordem.
Os três primeiros podem compartilhar medalhas: não se força diversidade à custa da pontuação.
